snippet.title: Kevin's In Trouble - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
About the Game:
Kevin’s In Trouble is a top-down roguelite deckbuilding bullet heaven where you'll battle through unrelenting waves of enemies while building a deck of powerful weapons and perks to survive the gauntlet, defeat the bosses, and escape!

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3940120/Kevins_In_Trouble/
